title: Societal Resilience and Misuse Defense
subtitle: Societal misuse defense should be operated as a domain-specific resist-absorb-recover-adapt network with shared incident… response, correction, and residual ownership; prevention metrics alone establish neither resilience nor acceptable harm.

display.problem: Model safeguards and internal incident command cannot by themselves protect… diffuses across platforms, or harms exploit social and infrastructural vulnerabilities.
display.insufficient: A classifier, terms of service, model refusal, takedown queue, or company-local incident process sees only one control point.

mechanism.label: Maintain domain playbooks fraud
mechanism.detail: Maintain domain playbooks for fraud and impersonation… misuse, biological/chemical misuse, manipulation, and vulnerable-user harms.

mechanism.label: Shared incident identifiers
mechanism.detail: Define shared incident identifiers, severity, evidence minimums… contacts, and status transitions across participating organizations.

mechanism.label: Layer prevention friction detection
mechanism.detail: Layer prevention, friction, detection, rapid patching, victim… adaptation instead of depending on one classifier.

mechanism.label: Defense-favoring capability
mechanism.detail: Measure defense-favoring capability by time-to-detect, time-to-contain, prevented… false intervention, coverage, accessibility, and total burden.
